It differs from slicing-based voxelization by rasterizing the scene approximately once rather than $N$ times (where $N$ is the volume resolution), making image-space performance insensitive to scene complexity [S1, unofficial].

The evidence explicitly states in the 'Comparisons' section (6.3) that 'the slice-based voxelization method needs to rasterize the model the same times as the resolution of the volume along z direction' (which corresponds to N times). It contrasts this with the proposed method, noting in Section 6.1 that 'As the algorithm traverses the model approximately once, its performance is insensitive to the scene complexity.' The notes also summarize this comparison directly. Therefore, every part of the claim is supported by the text.
